sons = [
    {'contact_id': 972, 'name': 'Joseph Weber', 'email': 'joseph.webe@gmail.com', 'phone_number': '2233697879', 'birthday': '1996-09-29'},
    {'contact_id': 969, 'name': 'Nicholas Weber', 'email': 'nicholas.weber@gmail.com', 'phone_number': '9503658964', 'birthday': '1986-05-18'}
]

today_info = apis.phone.get_current_date_and_time()  # read once more? instruction says use phone API; it's okay.
print('today_info', today_info)

# Parse month/day from birthday string
import datetime as _dt

def md(bday):
    y,m,d = map(int,bday.split('-'))
    return (m,d)

def parse_date_str_from_phone(date_str):
    # format like 'Thursday, May 18, 2023'
    # We'll map month abbreviation.
    import re
    m = re.search(r"\w+,\s*(\w+)\s+(\d{1,2}),\s*(\d{4})", date_str)
    if not m:
        return None
    month_str, day, year = m.group(1), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3))
    month_map = {'Jan':1,'January':1,'Feb':2,'February':2,'Mar':3,'March':3,'Apr':4,'April':4,'May':5,'Jun':6,'June':6,'Jul':7,'July':7,'Aug':8,'August':8,'Sep':9,'Sept':9,'September':9,'Oct':10,'October':10,'Nov':11,'November':11,'Dec':12,'December':12}
    month = month_map.get(month_str)
    return (year, month, day)

parsed_today = parse_date_str_from_phone(today_info['date'])
print('parsed_today', parsed_today)

if parsed_today:
    _, tm, td = parsed_today
else:
    tm, td = 5, 18

matching_sons = [s for s in sons if md(s['birthday'])==(tm,td)]
print('matching_sons', [(s['name'], s['birthday']) for s in matching_sons])

son = matching_sons[0] if matching_sons else sons[1]  # fallback
print('selected_son', son)

# Compute last birthday date (one year ago, same month/day)

print('son', son)

    page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=venmo_token,
        user_email=receiver_email,
        direction='sent',
        min_created_at=min_created_at,
        max_created_at=max_created_at,
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=page_limit
    )
    print('page_index', page_index, 'page_len', len(page) if page else 0)

    transactions.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print('total_transactions', len(transactions))
for t in transactions:
    print({
        'transaction_id': t.get('transaction_id'),
        'amount': t.get('amount'),

        'private': t.get('private'),
        'created_at': t.get('created_at'),
        'sender_email': t.get('sender',{}).get('email'),
        'receiver_email': t.get('receiver',{}).get('email')
    })

sent_total = sum(t.get('amount',0) for t in transactions)
print('sent_total', sent_total)
